scripts.text:

Besides me, there are other
Cute Pet Managers. If you want

scripts.translation:

除了我之外，还有其他宠物管理员。
如果您想驯服其他宠物，

scripts.text:
[Cute Pet Manager]
Hello~! I am a Cute Pet Manager
who is in charge of public relations
for the New Upgraded Cute Pet system.
scripts.translation:
[宠物管理员]
您好~！我是负责新升级宠物系统
公关工作的宠物管理员。

scripts.text:
[Cute Pet Manager]
If you have any concerns regarding
the Cute Pet system I am here to guide you.
Let me know which taming
item you want,
then I will tell you the monster
that you can tame with the item.
scripts.translation:
[宠物管理员]
如果您有关于宠物系统的疑问，
我会为您提供指导。
请告诉我您想要哪种驯服道具，
我会告诉您可以用该道具驯服的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Cute Pet Manager]
Also I will explain what materials
you need to bring in order to
get the taming item.
scripts.translation:
[宠物管理员]
我还会向您解释
为了获得驯服道具
需要携带哪些材料。

scripts.text:
[Cute Pet Manager]
If you already brought materials
to exchange for the taming item,
I can exchange it for taming items immediately.
scripts.translation:
[宠物管理员]
如果您已经携带了用于兑换驯服道具的材料，
我可以立即为您兑换。

scripts.text:
[Cute Pet Manager]
However, there is a limit
for exchanging taming items.
You can only get taming items
{0} times. So please make sure
how many times you have exchanged.
scripts.translation:
[宠物管理员]
不过，兑换驯服道具是有次数限制的。
您只能兑换{0}次。所以请确认
您已经兑换了多少次。

scripts.text:
[Cute Pet Manager]
So, which taming item do you want?
Please choose one from the list.
scripts.translation:
[宠物管理员]
那么，您想要哪种驯服道具？
请从列表中选择一项。

scripts.text:
[Cute Pet Manager]
Ah, you have gathered all items
with your friends. You can now
exchange for an {0}.
Do you want to exchange with me?
scripts.translation:
[宠物管理员]
啊，您和朋友们已经集齐了所有物品。
现在您可以兑换{0}了。
您想要兑换吗？

scripts.text:
[Cute Pet Manager]
You don't? You will come back again.
scripts.translation:
[宠物管理员]
您不兑换吗？您还会再回来的。

scripts.text:
[Cute Pet Manager]
Wise choice.
I hope you and your pet get along.
scripts.translation:
[宠物管理员]
明智的选择。
希望您和您的宠物相处融洽。

scripts.text:
[Cute Pet Manager]
You have chosen {0}.
You can use it for taming
^FF0000{1}^000000 monsters.
scripts.translation:
[宠物管理员]
您选择了{0}。
您可以使用它来驯服
^FF0000{1}^000000魔物。

scripts.text:
[Cute Pet Manager]
Bring ^FF0000{0} {1}^000000{2} ^000000 and ^FF00001 Dolly Capsule^000000
then you can exchange them
for an {3}.
